args.description: leans forward and reaches out with her free open hand, closes it on empty air, then pulls back, the other hand keeping a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons still at her side; nothing leaves her hands. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young woman with very long silver hair, a blue ribbon and violet eyes, a closed high-collared black and white top, a long black coat, loose black shorts reaching her knees over fully opaque black tights from waist to ankle, black boots, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
